props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted file types (e.g., ".jpg,.png", "image/*").

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Description text for the upload area.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: dropzone
props.description: Whether files can be dropped onto the control.

props.name: fileIcon
props.description: Icon to show for individual files when no preview is available.

props.name: fileList
props.description: Whether to show the list of selected files, including image thumbnails.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to show in the upload area.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Native input element ref.

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Custom renderer for individual file entries in the file list.

props.name: label
props.description: Label for the upload area.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Maximum number of files allowed. Only accepted when `multiple` is true; single mode always keeps one file.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum accepted file size in bytes.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum accepted file size in bytes.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple files can be uploaded.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with the files rejected by type, size, duplicate, or count rules.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the selected file(s) change.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this file upload instance.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the control: a large dashed drop area, or a compact picker button.
